opening.text: I'm here because I've been gaining weight, which I first noticed about three months ago. I've also been feeling chilly a lot, my hair is falling out more than usual, and my skin feels dry. My periods have gotten longer too; I usually had a 4-week cycle, but recently it's been 6 weeks or more. I have bipolar disorder and I started taking lithium six months ago.
